source.split: disjoint task families; fresh seed range 100-123

protocol.selection: lowest combined validation objective; fresh seeds were not used to select checkpoints
protocol.score: changed-pixel-weighted MSE; lower is better; paired alternative is an independently observed action from the same reset state

finding: Higher resolution improved absolute pixel prediction for the default objective but not reliable action grounding: swapped actions still beat correct actions. The 64x64 pairwise model's 0.000002991 weighted-MSE advantage is too small to support promotion.
limitations: Selected click pairs and a 24-pair fresh-seed evaluation do not estimate general task success.
The action-grounding comparison is descriptive after exploratory objective and resolution changes, not an untouched model-selection benchmark.
Research weights are neither loaded by the daemon nor authorized to gate actions; no real desktop transfer or Jev parity has been shown.
